questions.prompt: Quanto tempo impiega Salif per raggiungere Fela?
questions.promptZh: Salif 到 Fela 那里需要多久？
questions.explanationZh: 官方文字稿中，Fela 回答到他那里约需半小时；不要把提到的“一秒钟就发火”当成路程时间。

questions.prompt: Per quale motivo Salif esprime ammirazione per Fela?
questions.promptZh: Salif 为什么表达对 Fela 的赞赏？
options: Perché fa il massimo per studiare.
Perché conosce già tutte le espressioni.
questions.explanationZh: 官方讲解说明 Fela 在学习中尽力而为，Salif 的赞赏正是针对这一努力，并非说他已经学会全部表达。

questions.prompt: Come reagisce Olga al regalo di Fela?

questions.explanationZh: 官方文字稿在介绍人物情绪时说明，Olga 最后因 Fela 的礼物而感动；此前的失望与争吵不能代替这一反应。

questions.prompt: After taking exit 13A, what should a driver do next?

Drive down the road and turn left.
Stop at the bus station in Brownsville.

questions.prompt: What should someone travelling by bus do on reaching Brownsville?
questions.promptZh: 乘公交的人到达Brownsville后应该做什么？

Take another bus to the house.
Walk to the first house on Forest Road.
Wait for the speaker at exit 13A.
questions.explanationZh: 对公交乘客的安排是乘80路到Brownsville，到达后打电话，让人开车来接。
